cases.question: ¿Cuántas mesas registradas están activas en el salón?

cases.question: Total facturado de boletas emitidas con estado Issued.

cases.question: ¿Cuántos comprobantes de venta de tipo Factura se han emitido?

cases.question: Monto total vendido por cada método de pago registrado en ventas.

cases.question: Top 5 productos con mayor cantidad vendida en ítems de pedidos.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades_vendidas FROM order_item oi JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 5;

cases.question: Total de ventas por cliente que superen los 1000 soles acumulados.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.business_name, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_cliente FROM sales_invoice si JOIN customer c ON si.customer_id = c.id WHERE si.status = 'Issued' GROUP BY c.id, c.business_name HAVING SUM(si.total_amount) > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_cliente DESC;

cases.question: Pedidos de mesa cerrados con tiempo de atención y monto total de ítems.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT so.id, so.order_number, dt.number AS mesa, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_pedido FROM sales_order so JOIN order_table ot ON so.id = ot.order_id JOIN dining_table dt ON ot.table_id = dt.id JOIN order_item oi ON so.id = oi.order_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.order_type = 'Mesa' GROUP BY so.id, so.order_number, dt.number;

cases.question: Ranking de ventas mensuales con función de ventana por producto y porcentaje sobre el total del mes.
cases.expected_sql: WITH ventas_prod AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', so.ordered_at) AS mes, p.id AS prod_id, p.name AS producto, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_prod FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON so.id = oi.order_id JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', so.ordered_at), p.id, p.name) SELECT mes, producto, total_prod, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mes ORDER BY total_prod DESC) AS ranking, ROUND((total_prod / SUM(total_prod) OVER (PARTITION BY mes)) * 100, 2) AS pct_mes FROM ventas_prod ORDER BY mes DESC, ranking ASC;

cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0.00) AS total_pagado, (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0.00)) AS saldo_pendiente FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON pi.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN purchase_payment pp ON pi.id = pp.purchase_invoice_id WHERE pi.active = true GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name, pi.id, pi.series, pi.number, pi.total_amount HAVING (pi.total_amount - COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount), 0.00)) > 0 ORDER BY saldo_pendiente DESC;

cases.question: Balance de comprobación por cuenta mayor (2 dígitos) para asientos contables válidos.

cases.question: Detección de asientos descuadrados con diferencia mayor a un céntimo entre debe y haber.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.id, je.entry_code, je.entry_date, je.glosa, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber, ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) AS descuadre FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON je.id = jed.entry_id WHERE je.status = true GROUP BY je.id, je.entry_code, je.entry_date, je.glosa HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY descuadre DESC;
